security.note: sms_twilio defines NO own res.groups; 2 ir.model.access entries scope the two technical models (sms.twilio.number, sms.twilio.account.manage). Credentials (sms_twilio_account_sid, sms_twilio_auth_token) are protected at the field level via groups='base.group_system' on res.company, not by a record rule.

views.note: No standalone primary views; 3 data files inject Twilio config into res.config.settings, add a sid column to the sms.sms list, and define the sms.twilio.account.manage wizard form (92 XML LOC total).

behavioral_notes.observation: SmsApiTwilio subclasses sms's SmsApiBase and replaces the IAP wire path. Instead of one batched IAP jsonrpc it opens a requests.Session and loops message-by-message, number-by-number, POSTing to the Twilio REST endpoint https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{account_sid}/Messages.json with form data {From, To, Body, StatusCallback}. Auth is HTTP Basic (auth=(account_sid, auth_token)) with a 5s timeout. The From number is chosen per destination country via get_twilio_from_number (matches sms.twilio.number.country_code to the to_number's country, else first number). On success it returns {state:'sent', sms_twilio_sid: response_json['sid']}; invisible to metadata.

Per-message Twilio numeric error codes are mapped to Odoo sms.sms states/failure_types: 21211/21614/21265 -> wrong_number_format, 21604 -> sms_number_missing, 21266 -> twilio_from_to, 21603 -> twilio_from_missing, 21608 -> twilio_acc_unverified, 21609 -> twilio_callback, else 'unknown'. PROVIDER_TO_SMS_FAILURE_TYPE extends the base dict (twilio_authentication->sms_credit, twilio_acc_unverified->sms_acc, ...). A RequestException (network/timeout) gives response=None -> state 'server_error'. Failure types twilio_authentication/twilio_callback/twilio_from_missing/twilio_from_to are added via selection_add on both sms.sms and mail.notification.

Provider choice is per-company: _split_by_api groups outgoing sms by _get_sms_company() (record_company_id or mail_message_id.record_company_id) and, for companies whose res.company.sms_provider=='twilio', yields company._get_sms_api_class()(env) (= SmsApiTwilio) bound via _set_company; the rest fall through to super() (IAP). _get_send_batch_size drops to ir.config_parameter sms_twilio.session.batch.size (default 10) since Twilio is sequential. Because the sms.sms row is GC'd after send, _handle_call_result_hook persists the returned Twilio SID onto the surviving sms.tracker.sms_twilio_sid.

Public http POST route (csrf=False) receives Twilio's StatusCallback. It validates the uuid (32 hex), maps SmsStatus via TWILIO_TO_SMS_STATE (queued->outgoing, sending->process, sent->pending, delivered->sent, failed/undelivered->error, canceled->canceled), and verifies authenticity with _validate_twilio_signature: it recomputes HMAC-SHA1 over url+sorted-params keyed by the company's auth_token (generate_twilio_sms_callback_signature) and hmac.compare_digest's it against the X-Twilio-Signature header. On match it updates sms.tracker -> mail.notification (errors route to _action_update_from_twilio_error, mapping Twilio 30002-30008 codes to failure types), then marks the sms.sms to_delete=True.

Twilio credentials live on res.company: sms_twilio_account_sid + sms_twilio_auth_token (both groups='base.group_system', admin-only at the ORM field level) and a One2many sms_twilio_number_ids of sender numbers. _assert_twilio_sid validates SID format (starts 'AC', 34 chars, alphanumeric). The transient sms.twilio.account.manage wizard (related fields onto the company) lets an admin set provider/SID/token; action_reload_numbers GETs https://api.twilio.com/.../IncomingPhoneNumbers.json to import sender numbers, and action_send_test composes a real test SMS via sms.composer. No IAP account / no Odoo credits are involved on the Twilio path.

1 http_call_site using the requests SDK directly (no Twilio python SDK): outbound POST to api.twilio.com/Messages.json (send) and GET to /IncomingPhoneNumbers.json (number import), plus the inbound /sms_twilio/status webhook. Customer-held credentials (account SID + auth token) are stored per res.company and used for HTTP Basic auth and for HMAC-signing the callback. This replaces sms's Odoo-IAP gateway (https://sms.api.odoo.com) with the customer's own Twilio account.

classification.apqc_category: 9.4 Manage internal communications (firm-wide messaging-infrastructure category that houses mail/sms); the Twilio backend is a gateway swap, so it inherits its parent sms's APQC anchor and only touches a 3.x Market-and-Sell leaf (e.g. 3.5.4.8 Handle sales order inquiries, apqc_odoo_map.tsv, support) derivatively when the SMS notifies on a sales record.
classification.rationale: sms_twilio is a cross-cutting SUPPORT subsystem (Stabell & Fjeldstad) and the direct sibling of the IAP-based sms backend: messaging-infrastructure with no business object of its own. It owns only technical configuration models (sms.twilio.number, sms.twilio.account.manage) and otherwise inherits sms.sms / sms.tracker / sms.composer / mail.notification to redirect the delivery wire from Odoo IAP (https://sms.api.odoo.com) to the customer's own Twilio REST account, selected per res.company via sms_provider. It carries no value stream of its own - it plugs transparently into the mail.thread notification pipeline that sms already established. APQC best fit is therefore the same as its parent: 9.4 Manage internal communications, the communication-infrastructure category; a 3.x selling code applies only derivatively when an SMS happens to notify on a sale.order (anchored by 3.5.4.8 in apqc_odoo_map.tsv). The defining trait (gap #7) is the external integration: direct requests-based HTTP to api.twilio.com with HTTP Basic auth (account SID + auth token) for the Messages endpoint, plus an inbound HMAC-SHA1-signed /sms_twilio/status StatusCallback webhook - customer-held credentials replacing IAP's account_token + database.uuid.

standard_capabilities: Drop-in alternate SMS provider: set res.company.sms_provider='twilio' to route that company's SMS through Twilio instead of Odoo IAP
Twilio account configuration wizard (SID/auth token) with SID-format validation and a live test-SMS button
Automatic Twilio sender-number import (IncomingPhoneNumbers) with per-destination-country From selection
Per-message send to Twilio Messages REST API over HTTP Basic auth, returning the Twilio SID
Signed StatusCallback webhook (HMAC-SHA1 verification) feeding the existing sms.tracker -> mail.notification delivery state machine
Twilio error-code -> Odoo failure_type mapping surfaced through the standard SMS failure UI (message_has_sms_error)
typical_fits: Customer already has a Twilio account / regulated sender numbers and wants Odoo SMS without buying IAP credits
Multi-company setups needing a different SMS backend (or a different Twilio account) per company
All existing SMS flows (chatter SMS, sms.template, mass SMS) keep working unchanged - only the transport swaps
common_gaps: StatusCallback requires a publicly reachable base URL (web.base.url); localhost/ngrok needed for local testing
Sending is sequential (one HTTP request per recipient, 5s timeout, batch size default 10) - slower than IAP's batched call for large volumes
Grouping is by company only (code TODO: not yet by individual Twilio account/number pool)
Inbound/two-way SMS (replies) still not modeled - only outbound + delivery status
Requires the requests library and outbound HTTPS egress to api.twilio.com; credentials are company-stored secrets to safeguard

open_questions: Exact Twilio Messages API contract beyond the fields used (From/To/Body/StatusCallback) and full error-code coverage - only a curated subset of Twilio codes is mapped; others fall to 'unknown'.
Same APQC ambiguity as parent sms: a cross-cutting comms gateway has no single clean PCF leaf (9.4 internal comms vs 12.x external relationships vs derivative 3.5.4.8).
Live Twilio-dependent behavior (real delivery, number provisioning, signature round-trip) cannot be observed without a configured Twilio account and a public callback URL.
Stated TODO/RIGR refactors (move record_company_id onto SmsSms, group by provider/account rather than by company) are not yet implemented in this stable version.
